blocks.text: Yeh chapter hypothesis testing aur data ke tajzie mein us ka kirdar samjhata hai: hypothesis kya hai aur research ke sawal kaise test ke qabil hypotheses bante hain; null aur alternative hypotheses; test statistics, critical regions aur p-values; saade hisabi misalon ke saath qadam ba qadam testing; nataij pesh karne aur hypotheses se jorne ke liye data visualisation; bias jaise akhlaqi masail; aur nataij ki tashreeh aur nataij ka abalagh.

blocks.title: Hypothesis testing
blocks.text: Hypothesis testing aik shumariyati tareeqa hai jo namoone ke data se tay karta hai ke kisi daawe (mafrooze) ki tayeed ya radd ke liye kafi saboot hai ya nahi.

Hypothesis testing research aur tajzie mein aam use hoti hai. Yeh wazeh amal par chalti hai: data ehtiyat se jama aur tajzia hota hai, phir mafrooza qabool ya radd hota hai, is liye faisle andaze ke bajaye saboot par hote hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Hypothesis testing data se mafroozat jaanchti aur tay karne mein madad deti hai ke daawa sach hai ya nahi; yeh research aur tajrubaat mein use hoti, aur is ke nataij theek testing par munhasir hain.

blocks.title: Hypothesis
blocks.text: Hypothesis testing shuru hone se pehle kiya gaya test ke qabil bayan ya mafrooza hai, kisi population, surat-e-haal ya variables ke rishte ke baare mein.

Hypothesis kisi nateeje ki peshgoi karta hai, is liye use wazeh aur qabil-e-paimaish hona chahiye, aur data use jaanchne ke liye use hota hai. Achha hypothesis tehqeeq ko markooz aur tajzie ki rehnumai karta hai.

blocks.title: Machine learning mein doosra matlab
blocks.text: Kitab h_theta(x) = y bhi likhti hai, jahan h_theta(x) parameters theta (maslan linear regression ke coefficients) wala 'hypothesis function' hai jo input x par lagta hai, aur y andaza shuda output hai. Yeh machine learning wala matlab hai: model ka andaze ka qaida, jaise 6.6 ka Exam Score = 0.6552 x Hours + 0.1466. Yeh is chapter mein test hone wale shumariyati hypothesis se mukhtalif hai.

Research ka sawal tay karta hai ke kya parha ja raha hai aur data jama karne ki rehnumai karta hai; hypothesis sawal se banta aur mumkina jawab deta hai. Wazeh sawal wazeh hypotheses tak le jate hain, aur mil kar tehqeeq ko markooz simt dete hain.
Data tajzie mein hypothesis testing ka kirdar

Hypothesis testing data ka mantiqi tajzia kar ke dekhti hai ke nataij ba-maani hain ya ittifaq ho sakte hain. Yeh nataij ko tawaqqoat se mila kar be-tukke nataij se bachati, tajrubaat aur surveys mein durusti barhati, aur saboot par mabni faislon par aitmad barhati hai.

blocks.prompt: Is research sawal ko test ke qabil hypothesis banayein: 'Kya zyada sone wale talaba zyada score karte hain?'
blocks.explanation: Maslan: 'Raat ko kam az kam aath ghante sone wale talaba ka average score kam sone walon se zyada hai.' Is mein qabil-e-paimaish variables (neend ke ghante, average score) aur mutawaqqa farq shamil hai.

items: Hypothesis testing data se tay karti ke daawa radd ho ya nahi.
Hypothesis testing se pehle wazeh, qabil-e-paimaish, qabil-e-test bayan.
